generate_alt_text.title: Generate alt text for an image
generate_alt_text.description: Generate alt text for a publicly reachable image URL (no login pages, private networks or redirects; use a presigned URL for private S3 objects), in any of 130+ languages and one of four writing styles, optionally steered by SEO keywords, product metadata (e-commerce mode) and page context. Returns the text in `result` with status generated or failed; credits are only charged when generated. customFields are echoed back untouched, for matching results to your own assets. Rate limits: 5 requests/second, 120/minute, 100,000/day.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image, directly accessible without authentication or redirects.

lang.description: Language code for the alt text, e.g. en, pl, de. Defaults to the account's language setting.

style.description: Writing style. Defaults to the account setting (neutral out of the box).

keywords.description: Keywords to include or emphasise for SEO; used only where they fit the image naturally.

product.description: E-commerce mode: product name or type, e.g. sneakers. Any e-commerce field switches the mode on.

brand.description: E-commerce mode: brand name, e.g. Nike.

color.description: E-commerce mode: dominant colour or palette, e.g. black.

material.description: E-commerce mode: product material, e.g. leather.

person_name.description: Context: name of the main person depicted.

page_title.description: Context: title of the page where the image appears.

section_heading.description: Context: heading of the section containing the image.

context_description.description: Context: an editorial description or explanation of the image.

surrounding_text.description: Context: text near the image, such as a caption or paragraph.

custom_fields.description: Up to 30 string key/value pairs (keys up to 70 chars, values up to 250) returned unchanged in the response, e.g. {"sku": "TSHIRT-001"}. No effect on generation.

result.description: The generated alt text, null on failure.

count.description: Character count of the alt text.
